doc.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Joe Williams and the White House Newport anniversary
summary: Mention of Joe Williams leads to the White House Newport Jazz Festival fortieth anniversary event with many stars and Bill Clinton on sax.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Wow. This has been really fascinating. I appreciate your joining us. Our viewers don’t know but it’s what about 12:30 at night right now.
Someday we’ll have to hook you up with a good friend of ours at Hamilton is Joe Williams, and he has actually mentioned your name a couple of times, and —

Oh yeah? Oh man, that’s good news. I had a chance to work with him once at the White House. They had the fortieth anniversary of the Newport Jazz Festival. That was a huge event, on public television stations and Joe Williams was there and Clark Terry, Wynton Marsalis, John Lewis, Herbie Hancock, Bobby McFerrin, Bill Clinton played saxophone on “All Blues.” It was funny.
That’s one for the scrapbook I guess.
